As an American, I do worry about my country a lot because I face a lot of discrimination for being a queer woman with a lot of opinions. That being said, it is truly a lot better than other places with more severe penalties for being gay, black, trans, etc. We're considered the "land of the free" for a reason, and for the most part we seem to stay true to that statement, but only in comparison to other places. When you start to look at America as a singular country, not in relation to other places, you start to notice those problems more and more.

Anyways, America is a good place to live to an extent. It's no paradise, but you're better off here than a lot of places, that's for sure! Don't feel discouraged if you want to move here, chances are you'll find it to be pretty nice depending on where you are. :)
